en.headline: Observatory forecasts mainly cloudy weekend with light rain patches
en.dek: A fresh easterly airstream will bring windier conditions and a few rain patches on Saturday and Sunday before the weather turns finer and drier early next week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a fresh easterly airstream would make conditions windier over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow and at first on the Chung Yeung Festival, bringing one or two rain patches.

On Saturday, east winds of force 4, occasionally force 5, are expected. It will be mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches in the morning and at night, with sunny intervals during the day. Temperatures should range from 27 to 30 degrees Celsius and relative humidity from 70 to 90 per cent. The probability of significant rain is low.

Sunday, the Chung Yeung Festival, will see east winds of force 4, occasionally force 5 on high ground at first. The morning is expected to be mainly cloudy with one or two light rain patches, becoming dry with sunny periods during the day. Temperatures are forecast at 27 to 31 degrees Celsius with relative humidity between 60 and 85 per cent, and a low chance of significant rain.

With an anticyclone aloft strengthening, the weather is expected to become mainly fine and dry over the coast of southern China early to midweek next week, and hot during the day. Monday, a public holiday, is forecast to be fine, dry and hot under light east winds of force 2 to 3, with temperatures from 26 to 32 degrees Celsius. No weather warnings are currently in force.

zh.headline: 天文台料周末大致多雲有一兩陣雨 下周初轉天晴乾燥
zh.dek: 受清勁偏東氣流影響，周六及周日風勢較大，有一兩陣雨，重陽節初時雲量較多，稍後至下周初漸轉天晴乾燥。
body: 香港天文台表示，一股清勁的偏東氣流影響下，明日及重陽節初時廣東沿岸風勢較大，有一兩陣雨。
周六吹東風4級，間中5級。大致多雲，早晚有一兩陣雨，日間短暫時間有陽光。氣溫27至30度，相對濕度百分之70至90，顯著降雨概率低。
周日重陽節吹東風4級，初時高地間中5級。早上大致多雲，有一兩陣微雨，日間部分時間有陽光及乾燥。氣溫27至31度，相對濕度百分之60至85，顯著降雨概率低。
隨著高空反氣旋增強，下週初至中期華南沿岸大致天晴及乾燥，日間炎熱。周一公眾假期料天晴、乾燥及炎熱，吹東風2至3級，氣溫26至32度。現時沒有天氣警告生效。
